title: Core Web Vitals for Frontend Engineers

scenes.say: Core Web Vitals are key metrics for web performance. But why are they so important for frontend engineers?

scenes.label: LCP
scenes.sub: Largest Contentful Paint: measures loading speed.
scenes.say: LCP stands for Largest Contentful Paint. It tracks how quickly the main content loads.

scenes.label: INP
scenes.sub: Interaction to Next Paint: measures input delay.
scenes.say: INP means Interaction to Next Paint. It measures how fast the page responds to user input.

scenes.label: CLS
scenes.sub: Cumulative Layout Shift: measures visual stability.
scenes.say: CLS is Cumulative Layout Shift. It checks if elements move unexpectedly while loading.
For a great user experience, aim for LCP under two point five seconds, INP under two hundred milliseconds, and CLS below zero point one.

scenes.title: Monitor Core Web Vitals
scenes.say: Use tools like Lighthouse or the Web Vitals library to monitor and improve your scores.

scenes.question: What does CLS measure?
scenes.right: Visual stability—if elements shift during load
scenes.say: In interviews, don’t confuse CLS with loading speed. It measures visual stability, not how fast content loads.
